episodes.title: Nova and Aala 01 - The Thinning
episodes.subtitle: A Nova and Aala Introductory Quest
episodes.sourceName: Nova and Aala/Nova and Aala 01 - The Thinning/Nova-and-Aala-01-The-Thinning.pdf-project.json

paragraphs: Now, if you ever find yourself standing at the edge of a moonwell in Shadowglen, take a moment before you do anything else. Just look at it. It's so silver and so still that it seems to be quietly correcting the moon's homework, and it has been doing this, patiently, since long before anyone thought to build a path to it.
It was beside this moonwell that Nova stood one morning, reading a note for the third time, as if reading it a fourth time might make it more helpful.
Conservator Ilthalaine requests your assistance at the moonwell clearing. Bring your staff.
That was all it said. No explanation. No "dear Nova, hope this finds you well." Just an order, politely disguised as a request, the way orders from conservators so often are.

Nova was, by nature, the sort of person who liked to know things before she did them. Not knowing things made her nervous, and being nervous made her hold her spellbook a little too tightly against her chest, which is exactly what she was doing when she crossed the root-bridge and saw that someone had gotten there first.

The someone was a draenei, robed plainly, staff planted in the moss with the easy confidence of a person who has never once worried about looking silly. They were watching the moonwell with the patient expression of someone who had already decided the day was going to be interesting, one way or another.
"You got a note too," said the draenei, without turning around. It wasn't really a question.
"I did," said Nova. "I don't suppose you know what it's about."
"Not the faintest idea." A pause, and then, over one shoulder: "I'm Aala. I was told to bring my staff, so either we're being tested, or somebody very important has misplaced something very small."

Nova laughed before she meant to, which she found almost as surprising as the joke itself. "Nova," she said, and didn't get the chance to say much else, because that was precisely the moment Conservator Ilthalaine arrived — moss-robed, staff in hand, moving like someone who had already had a very long morning and intended to have several more.

Now, a word about Ilthalaine. She was the sort of elder who had clearly seen every kind of trouble a forest could produce, filed it neatly away, and was fully prepared to see it all again. She did not waste words. She did not waste time. And when she pointed her staff out past the water, both apprentices understood, instantly, that whatever was wrong was wrong in a big way.

"The spring rains were generous this year," Ilthalaine said. "Too generous." Beyond the moonwell, the ferns were doing something ferns are not supposed to do — trembling with far too much traffic. A trio of thistle boars shouldered past each other like impatient customers at a very small bakery. Somewhere in the shadows, a nightsaber slid past and vanished, the way nightsabers do, as if the forest had simply blinked.

"Boar and nightsaber alike have multiplied beyond what the glen can feed," Ilthalaine went on. "If they are not encouraged outward — gently — they will starve, or turn on one another for what little is left."
Nova's mind, which liked things sorted into tidy piles, sorted this immediately. "So we're not hunting them. We're moving them along."

"Just so. Thin the crowded clusters. Send them to fuller ground. Enough to restore the balance." Ilthalaine looked at her — really looked, the way conservators do when they want you to remember something. "No more."
Aala's grip on their staff tightened, just slightly. "And if 'enough' turns out to mean more than that?" they asked. "If someone decides restraint is inconvenient?"
"Then I am trusting you," said Ilthalaine, "to be the one who remembers it isn't."

That seemed to settle something in Aala — though not entirely, because Aala turned to Nova next, studying her the way you might study a stranger you've just been handed a rope and told to trust with your life. Then, apparently satisfied, Aala grinned.
"So. Restore balance," they said gravely. "...Or bacon sandwiches?"
Nova blinked. "I'm sorry — what?"

"Nothing. Just checking you were listening." And there it was — Nova's first real look at the fact that she had just been paired, for reasons unknown, with someone who used jokes the way other people used shields.

They set off together down the root-lined path, wisps drifting between the roots like lazy lanterns, and Nova spent several strides deciding what on earth to say to a person she had known for less time than it takes to boil an egg.
"Bacon sandwiches," she said eventually, mostly to herself.
Aala laughed — a proper, delighted laugh. "Hee hee hee. Got you."
"I nearly believed the Conservator had lost her mind."
"To be fair," said Aala, "I hadn't ruled that out either."
It is, I should tell you, a very unusual way to begin a friendship. But then, the best ones often begin unusually.

The path soon dipped through fern beds gone ragged at the edges — not the gentle raggedness of wind and weather, but the sorry, flattened raggedness of far too many hooves. Nova crouched to look. "It's not just a few animals," she said. "There's so many they're even trampling the ferns."
Aala's humor dropped away like a cloak shrugged off. "Then we'll be quick," they said, "and gentle where we can."

Deeper in, things only got worse. Webwood silk hung where silk had no business hanging. Boar-scars tore up the soft earth. Saplings stood stripped and bent, like they'd been leaned on by something enormous and thoroughly unbothered about it. Nova and Aala slowed at the edge of a grove gone thick with all this trouble, and for a moment, neither one of them said anything at all.

The clearing beyond held the worst of it — four or five thistle boars packed into a space built for one, jostling like too many people trying to use the same doorway at once, with more shapes shifting in the brush beyond.
Aala's steadiness wavered, just for a heartbeat. "So many," they murmured. "They can't help it."
"No," Nova agreed. "But we can."

She lifted her staff. She had practiced this spell a hundred times in empty rooms, on nothing more dangerous than dust motes, and never once on anything that could run away from her. A pale glow gathered at the staff's tip.
"A gentle push is all it should take," she said. "Watch."

And she let it go — not a blow, not a blast, nothing you'd write a song about, just a slow, curling pressure that eased around the boars like a polite but very firm usher clearing a theater. The boars startled, shuffled, and peeled away toward the wider thickets, entirely unharmed and entirely unimpressed, which is really the best outcome you can hope for from a thistle boar.
Aala let out a long breath, shoulders loosening. "With the boars moved on," they said, watching the last one vanish, "hopefully the rest will find new homes too."

For a moment, the clearing was simply quiet, and quiet, as any storyteller will tell you, is when the important things tend to happen. Aala rested a hand near Nova's shoulder — careful, testing, the way you'd offer a hand to someone you weren't yet sure would take it.
"It was amazing, Nova."

Nova felt her face go warm. "I'm still so glad we didn't hurt them," she admitted — more honestly than the moment probably called for. But Aala only nodded, as though that one small admission had told them something worth knowing.
They might have lingered there longer, if Aala hadn't crouched, a breath later, beside a moss-covered root and gone very still. Four deep gouges, freshly clawed into the wood.
"Take care," Nova said, all her ease folding back into alertness. "These are nightsaber hunting grounds. They can appear out of —"
She never finished the sentence, because the shadows above them chose that exact moment to move.

"EEEEEEP — it's above us!" Aala's staff came up faster than thought, and a shimmering ward flared into being overhead, just as a nightsaber's leap came down toward them — all claws and shadow and considerably more weight than either of them wanted to think about.

Nova didn't have time to be frightened. She only had time to cast — a curling ribbon of pale light spooling out from her staff, bending gently around Aala's ward, catching the nightsaber's leap and steering it sideways, as harmlessly as steering a runaway cart.
"Be gone," she said — and she said it kindly, if firmly, which is a very Nova sort of thing to do even to a beast trying to eat her.

The nightsaber twisted mid-air, landed hard but whole, shook itself off with the deeply offended air of a cat that has just missed a jump on purpose, and slunk away into the trees without so much as a backward glance.
For a moment, neither of them moved. Then Aala let their breath out in one long, shaky, delighted laugh, and lowered the ward.
"That was the last one, I think," they said. "GG."

Now, Nova had no idea what those two letters meant. But she understood the feeling behind them perfectly well — that giddy, wobbly-kneed relief of having done something difficult and come out the other side of it whole, standing next to someone she had met only that morning and somehow already trusted with her life. She decided she didn't need to know what it meant. She suspected she'd be hearing it again.

They walked back to the moonwell slower than they'd left it, unhurried, the whole glen settling into a calm that hadn't been there before. Ilthalaine was waiting, and turned to greet them with the look of someone who already knew, somehow, exactly how the morning had gone.
"You've kept the balance," she said, drawing two folded cloaks from beneath her arm — moss-and-leaf toned, plain, and entirely new. "Wear these with pride."

Nova took hers with a quiet, surprised sort of pride she hadn't expected to feel over a piece of cloth. Aala accepted theirs with a grin, shrugging off the travel cloak they'd arrived in that morning as though it belonged to someone they'd already outgrown.
"Matching cloaks," Nova said, settling hers into place, fighting a smile of her own. "Try not to make it weird."
"No promises," said Aala.

And so they stood there together at the water's edge a little longer than the task strictly required — two strangers who had walked into Shadowglen's ferns that morning, and walked out of them as something else entirely. Not quite friends yet. But you could see the shape of it forming already, plain as two matching cloaks in the moonlight.

pages.storyFunction: Establish the waypost through three linked evening vignettes as Nova and Aala settle in for the night.

panels.title: Evening at the Stable
panels.caption: A few quests later, and Nova and Aala are at the Hollowroot Waypost.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Smells like stew night. Brace yourself, apprentice.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: I've survived worse… I think?

panels.title: The Shed That Passes for a Room

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: At least the crates make excellent shelving.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Could be worse, my bunk room on the ship that fled our dying home world had less legroom than this. Crate palace is a real upgrade.

pages.storyFunction: Open the communal meal: the crowded hall, physical closeness, and the first layer of banter before backstory surfaces.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Excuse me — just relocating your elbow.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Huh? I thought you loved my elbows in your personal space.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Sample logged: broth, root vegetable, something structurally similar to meat.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Definitely a step up from rations on a dying world, though don't tell Cook I said the bar was low.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Nuuuu, not the loaf again.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Every ciao time is loaf time! Like clockwork. I've started taking bets on how burnt it will be.

pages.storyFunction: The meal's quiet turn inward: Aala's exile history, Nova's lighter origin story, and a warm closing payoff.

panels.title: What Couldn't Be Mended
panels.caption: Between second helpings, the noise seemed to fall away.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: My people fled a dying world generations before I was born. You learn to tend what's still standing... Also, you learn to season stew properly. Priorities.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: I wasn't fleeing anything, I "borrowed" a spellbook I wasn't supposed to read, and my mentor caught me elbow-deep in forbidden theory. Next minute, I found myself here.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Nova and forbidden theory. That's Very on-brand.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: This is yesterday’s loaf, I’d bet my staff on it.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Don't. You'll need the staff more than the bet, but props to the loaf — persistent little thing.

episodes.subtitle: Shadowglen, Phases One and Two

pages.storyFunction: Arrival at the moonwell and first encounter with the priestess (Phase 1)

panels.title: Between the Two Pools
panels.caption: Beneath the great tree Aldrassil, the Moonwell's keeps their watch. Nova and Aala were sent to help out.

dialogueLines.speaker: dentaria
dialogueLines.text: Nova, Aala I hear your training is going well. I am so glad you have come to help.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: I see someone is hurt. How can we help?

pages.storyFunction: Deliver the full quest briefing and pass the departure gate (Phase 2 start)

dialogueLines.speaker: dentaria
dialogueLines.text: The Webwood Spiders have gone mad. They are usually so timid, but today one bit Iverron.

dialogueLines.speaker: dentaria
dialogueLines.text: What I need are more Lilies. You can find them around the edges of the ponds.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: By the ponds, near the water. We'll be quick.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: You can count on us. Back in a flash.

pages.storyFunction: Travel toward the ponds and the webwood encounter; Nova disperses the spiders and is bitten

panels.title: The Path North
panels.caption: North, toward the ponds — Usually the spiders keep to themselves.  Usually.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Stay away from the trees. They are covered in spiders.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Go quietly Nova, we don't want to upset them.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: OK, OK I'll ask them politely to leave.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Oww, one of them bit me. Guess my manners aren't  so great.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Nova! Let me see it.

pages.storyFunction: Aala heals Nova, then the pair gather the Moonpetal Lilies

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Hold still. This won't take long.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Thank you. Hee hee, the magic is cold and kind of tickles.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: ... Thank you. Next time I will go slow.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Moonpetal lilies. She wasn't exaggerating — they almost glow.

pages.storyFunction: Recovered from panel_slot page assignments

panels.title: What the Water Gave
panels.caption: By the water's edge, they'd found what the priestess needed.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Here are all of the Lilies we could carry. I hope it's enough.

dialogueLines.speaker: dentaria
dialogueLines.text: These will do perfectly. Thank you. Your swiftness is appreciated.

panels.title: A Darker Whisper
panels.caption: But the forest had more to ask of them.

dialogueLines.speaker: dentaria
dialogueLines.text: The spirits whisper of more to be done. Tarindrella has returned in the north. Go now to find her.

episodes.title: Nova and Aala 04 - The Shadowthread Corruption
episodes.subtitle: Shadowglen Beginnings, Book Four
episodes.sourceName: Nova and Aala/Nova and Aala 04 - The Shadowthread Corruption/Nova-and-Aala-04-The-Shadowthread-Corruption.pdf-project.json

pages.storyFunction: The dangerous charge: Dentaria sends the pair to find Tarindrella and prepares them with the antidote.

panels.title: A Graver Charge
panels.caption: The pair prepared to head to the caves in the north. They were to seek out an ancient Dryad and aid her to rid Teldrassil of the Vile corruption afflicting it's inhabitants.

dialogueLines.speaker: dentaria
dialogueLines.text: Take this antidote with you, you might need it.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: A dryad, there hasn't been one here since before Teldrassil's blessing? It's exciting, and a sign that things are very wrong.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: A cave. I hate caves.

pages.storyFunction: Travel north; the darkening trail resolves on the cold Shadowthread cave mouth.

panels.title: North of the Moonwell
panels.caption: North of the moonwell, the canopy thickened and the light thinned.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Stay close. If anything attacks my shield will protect us.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: This silk is darker — corrupted, not just spun. The trail keeps going north. I'll mark it.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: After you, brave heart. Slowly though. Safety first.

pages.storyFunction: Inside the cave, the dryad Tarindrella is revealed (Phase 3 payoff) and names the task, offering to join (Phase 4 setup).

dialogueLines.speaker: tarindrella
dialogueLines.text: I see you found me, young ones. Dentaria was wise to send you.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: A dryad, for real. My mentor will never believe this.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: This whole nest is wrong to the touch. It is clearly sick.

dialogueLines.speaker: tarindrella
dialogueLines.text: These spiders suffer the corruption more deeply than any I have seen. We must be rid of them, and find the source.

pages.storyFunction: Thinning the corrupted brood (combat-lite) and investigating the corruption, ending on the grim Phase 4 diagnosis.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Whatever is hurting them, it isn't their fault, and how they are behaving isn't their choice.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Me and this staff, we can handle anything.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Sure,  of course you can.

dialogueLines.speaker: tarindrella
dialogueLines.text: This is no surface taint. It is bred into their very blood. Our path is clear.

pages.storyFunction: Descent to the far north of the cave (Phase 5 approach), resolving on the reveal of Githyiss the Vile.

dialogueLines.speaker: taindrella
dialogueLines.text: The broodmother Githyiss is the cause of this. Her lair lies at the end of the cave. There we will find the answers we seek.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Breathe. Together we can do this.

panels.title: Githyiss the Vile
panels.caption: At the cave's cold heart, broodmother Githyiss and an army of her offspring waited. Tarindrella would handle Githyiss while Nova and Aala tackled the offspring,

pages.storyFunction: Combat-lite confrontation with Githyiss, discovery of the corrupting furbolg totem (Phase 5 completion), and the Gnarlpine hook toward Phase 6.

dialogueLines.speaker: tarindrella
dialogueLines.text: Be still, poor thing. Your suffering ends here.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: You shield, I'll attack!

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Way ahead of you, they're all yours.

panels.title: A Wrong Glow
panels.caption: The foes were vanquished, but nothing was as it seemed.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: There — under the webbing. That glow isn't the cave.

panels.title: The Furbolg Totem
panels.caption: Further mystery is revealed, a furbolg totem. The Gnarlpine clan might be behind this.

panels.title: We Lowered Our Guard
panels.caption: One corruption ended — but a graver trail has begun.

dialogueLines.speaker: tarindrella
dialogueLines.text: I'll follow the trail to the Gnarlpine, for now you should return to Dentaria and report in.

episodes.title: Nova and Aala 05 - The Moonwell's Memory
episodes.subtitle: Shadowglen Beginnings — Phases 6-7
episodes.sourceName: Nova and Aala/Nova and Aala 05 - The Moonwell Memory/Nova-and-Aala-05-The-Moonwell-s-Memory.pdf-project.json

pages.storyFunction: Emerging from the cave; Tarindrella's farewell

panels.title: Daylight After the Dark
panels.caption: The corrupted brood lay silent behind them; ahead, the ordinary light of afternoon.

dialogueLines.speaker: tarindrella
dialogueLines.text: I'm heading north to find the Gnarlpine stronghold. Seek Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar if you need me.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Try not to vanish into the woods forever this time.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: We'll see you again, Tarindrella. I'm sure of it.

pages.storyFunction: Tarindrella's departure; arrival at Dentaria's moonwell

panels.title: Bark and Leaf
panels.caption: And with that, she was gone — bark and leaf folding back into forest.

dialogueLines.speaker: dentaria
dialogueLines.text: You've returned! It's good to see you both safe.

pages.storyFunction: Dentaria's welcome, Phase 6 close, Phase 7 briefing & acceptance

dialogueLines.speaker: dentaria
dialogueLines.text: You've dealt with the source of much of what plagued us.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Just a few spiders, barely broke a sweat.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: A few spiders?! One was bigger than a mammoth!

dialogueLines.speaker: dentaria
dialogueLines.text: Before you leave Shadowglen, one rite of training remains. Bring me a phial of water from the moonwell to the northeast.

dialogueLines.speaker: dentaria
dialogueLines.text: There you will glimpse a little of our history and magic.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: History, Dryad's, magic, can this day get any better?

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Umm, how about if we started at the beach with a nice cold...

pages.storyFunction: Travel to the second moonwell; arrival; approaching the water

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: I wonder what kind of magic she means. Old wards, maybe?

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Or maybe it's simpler than that — a place worth remembering and the magic of the past.

panels.title: A Quieter Water
panels.caption: Older than the training glade, this water had kept its own quiet counsel for centuries.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: You go on, this is for Night Elves. I'll keep watch.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Thank you.

pages.storyFunction: The rite triggers a vision of Shadowglen's ancient past

panels.title: The Water Stirred
panels.caption: The water stirred as Nova approached.

panels.title: What the Grove Remembered
panels.caption: For a heartbeat, the grove remembered everything it had ever been.

pages.storyFunction: Vision's aftermath; phial secured; journey back begins

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: I saw them. The first priestesses, keeping watch before any of us were born.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: What did it feel like?

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Like being small but also important at the same time.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Come on. Let's get that water to Dentaria before it gets ideas of its own.

pages.storyFunction: Phase 7 completion; forward hook to Phase 8

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Here, thank you for showing me that — everything I saw, I'll remember.

dialogueLines.speaker: dentaria
dialogueLines.text: Then you have already learned the lesson.

dialogueLines.speaker: dentaria
dialogueLines.text: One task remains before you leave Shadowglen for the wilds beyond.

episodes.title: Nova and Aala 06 - The Long Road to Dolanaar
episodes.subtitle: Shadowglen Beginnings — Phases 8-9
episodes.sourceName: Nova and Aala/Nova and Aala 06 - The Long Road to Dolanaar/Nova-and-Aala-06-The-Long-Road-to-Dolanaar.pdf-project.json

pages.storyFunction: The ascent of Aldrassil

panels.title: The Long Ramp
panels.caption: Dentaria had pressed the phial back into Nova's hands — the blessing was to be passed to Tenaron now.

pages.storyFunction: Arrival, presenting the phial, a quiet blessing

panels.title: The Keeper of the Ramp
panels.caption: At the ramp's end waited a keeper who had watched over the glade since before either of them were born.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Dentaria said this was meant for you.

dialogueLines.speaker: tenaron
dialogueLines.text: This gift has a habit of finding it's way to where it is needed I think.

dialogueLines.speaker: tenaron
dialogueLines.text: Be still a moment. The old magic works slowly.

pages.storyFunction: Tenaron's farewell speech and the pair's reactions

dialogueLines.speaker: tenaron
dialogueLines.text: Nova, you carry our people's curiosity like a torch. You will do great things for the Kaldorei, and for this world. Aala,  you don't need our blood to earn our respect. Shadowglen is safer for your kindness. We thank you.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: I don't know what to... thank you. I'll remember every word.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Careful, Tenaron. Keep talking like that and I'll probably cry.

pages.storyFunction: Training's completion; the vessel; the road; the warning

dialogueLines.speaker: tenaron
dialogueLines.text: There is much more to learn. What you began here continues through Teldrassil, and on into Darnassus.

dialogueLines.speaker: tenaron
dialogueLines.text: Corithras Moonrage awaits at Dolanaar's moonwell. This vessel carries what you brought me, for him.

dialogueLines.speaker: tenaron
dialogueLines.text: Follow the road south from Aldrassil, then west where the cobblestones turn.

dialogueLines.speaker: tenaron
dialogueLines.text: Mind you stay on the road though. There are dangerous beasts in the woods of late.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Stick to the road, beasts are cranky. Got it. Nova, think you can resist grabbing a rare plant specimen?

pages.storyFunction: Leaving Shadowglen's border; the road narrows; banter

panels.title: Past the Great Roots
panels.caption: The great roots of Aldrassil gave way to open road.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Feels strange, doesn't it? Leaving the only home we've had here.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: A little. But we're not leaving Dentaria behind, just her moonwell.

panels.title: Where the Canopy Thickens
panels.caption: The road narrowed as the canopy thickened overhead.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: If I trip and spill this, I will just hide in these woods forever.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Then hand it over before your imagination materialises fantasy into reality.

pages.storyFunction: The road turns west; a beast trace; tension eased

panels.title: Where the Cobblestones Turn
panels.caption: As Tenaron promised, the road bent west beneath a lowering sun.

panels.title: Something Passed This Way
panels.caption: Something big had passed this way, and not long ago.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Be alert, clearly Tenaron wasn't exaggerating.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Whatever it was, I think it's gone. But I'll keep my staff handy all the same.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: GG forest, you had us worried for a minute there.

pages.storyFunction: Arrival in Dolanaar; Corithras's greeting hook

panels.title: Smaller, But Just As Bright
panels.caption: By dusk, the road delivered them to Dolanaar — smaller than Shadowglen, but its moonwell just as bright.

dialogueLines.speaker: corithras
dialogueLines.text: Ah, sent by Tenaron were you? I am Corithras and we have much to talk about. But first, come. There's a lesson in this moonwell for you both.

episodes.title: Nova and Aala 07 - The Vision of Teldrassil
episodes.subtitle: Shadowglen Beginnings — Dolanaar, the Moonwell's Lesson
episodes.sourceName: Nova and Aala/Nova and Aala 07 - The Vision of Teldrassil/Nova-and-Aala-07-The-Vision-of-Teldrassil.pdf-project.json

pages.storyFunction: The vision begins

dialogueLines.speaker: corithras
dialogueLines.text: Kneel here, and let the water show you what it remembers.

panels.title: A Shade Approaches
panels.caption: The water rippled, and something old rose to meet them.

pages.storyFunction: What was lost

panels.title: Malfurion Gone
panels.caption: When Malfurion Stormrage was lost to us, and our immortality with him, the druids were left scattered — desperate for someone to lead them again.

panels.title: Fandral's Call
panels.caption: Fandral Staghelm rose to gather them, and carried his vision to the Circle of Ancients in Darkshore.

panels.title: The Circle's Approval
panels.caption: With the Circle's blessing, our strongest druids turned to a single, desperate hope: to grow ourselves a new home.

pages.storyFunction: The growing of Teldrassil

panels.title: Teldrassil Grows
panels.caption: From root to bough, Teldrassil rose — born of grief and defiance both.

pages.storyFunction: The charge given

panels.title: Still Unrestored
panels.caption: Yet even here, our immortal lives were not restored.

dialogueLines.speaker: shade
dialogueLines.text: It falls to hearts like yours now, to find the way we could not.

panels.title: The Shade Fades
panels.caption: The Shade closed its eyes, and let the water take it back into memory.

pages.storyFunction: Rest and a meal

panels.title: Settling In
panels.caption: That evening, Dolanaar offered them a small room, a warm meal, and nothing more urgent than rest.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Immortality, gone — an entire people rewriting their history around losing it. I could study that for a lifetime.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Or you could just feel sad for them, for a moment, before you study it.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: ... Right. Sorry. It really is sad, isn't it.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: My people know a little about losing what we can't get back.

pages.storyFunction: Morning's direction

panels.title: Morning Comes
panels.caption: Morning found Dolanaar quiet, its moonwell pale in the early light.

dialogueLines.speaker: corithras
dialogueLines.text: Sleep well? Good. There's someone else in Dolanaar who's been waiting on news like yours. Seek out Athridas Bearmantle. He knows this forest's troubles better than most including, I suspect, the one that sent you here.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Tarindrella did mention that name.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Then let's not keep him waiting any longer than we already have.

episodes.title: Nova and Aala 08 - Ashes of Starbreeze
episodes.subtitle: Shadowglen Beginnings — Book Five, Part One
episodes.sourceName: Nova and Aala/Nova and Aala 08 - Ashes of Starbreeze/Nova-and-Aala-08-Ashes-of-Starbreeze.pdf-project.json

pages.storyFunction: Briefing: the ask

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: You're doing the thing again, checking your spellbook's still there.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: It walked off once. I'm allowed to be careful.

panels.title: Athridas Arrives
panels.caption: Gaerolas Talvethren, Great Warden of Ban'ethil Barrow Den, has kept watch over its sleeping druids for as long as anyone can remember.

dialogueLines.speaker: athridas
dialogueLines.text: Good, you're both still here. Gaerolas has sent a report every day for years. Three days now, nothing.

dialogueLines.speaker: athridas
dialogueLines.text: If harm's found him, those druids may lie unguarded. Will you find him and bring back word?

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Of course. Which way?

pages.storyFunction: Travel, steady rhythm

panels.title: The Golden Road
panels.caption: On the road east to Starbreeze Village, the last place Gaerolas was seen.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Wrong way, my cute little friend, there's only trouble that way!

panels.title: An Easy Stretch
panels.caption: For a while, the road felt almost easy, full of warm sunlight and good conversation...

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: You're doing the thing with your grip again.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Gaerolas has never once missed a check-in. Three days now. It must be bad.

pages.storyFunction: Discovery payoff: the ruin

panels.title: Smoke on the Wind
panels.caption: The smell of smoke reached them before the village came into view.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Fan out slow. Eyes on the tree line.

panels.title: The Tree Line Breaks
panels.caption: Then the trees broke, and they saw where the smoke was coming from.

panels.title: Starbreeze in Ruin
panels.caption: Starbreeze Village. No birds. No voices. Only tracks in the mud.

pages.storyFunction: Investigation, parallel action

dialogueLines.speaker: gaerolas
dialogueLines.text: Thank the stars. I knew Athridas would send help.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Don't sit up. Just tell us slowly what happened.

dialogueLines.speaker: gaerolas
dialogueLines.text: The Gnarlpine did this. Their chieftain, Ursal the Mauler, had his sanity consumed by fel moss. It's driven the whole tribe mad.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: This is fel moss, and it's spreading fast and wide, it's already here in Starbreeze.

pages.storyFunction: Kinetic transition

panels.title: The Long Run Home
panels.caption: With Gaerolas stable and resting, there was no more time to lose. Athridas needed to hear this now.

pages.storyFunction: Grave report

panels.title: The Full Account
panels.caption: They told him everything. Starbreeze in ruins, Gaerolas wounded but stable, and the Gnarlpine behind it all, led by their corrupted chieftain, Ursal the Mauler.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Ursal's corrupted by fel moss. It's spreading through the whole tribe.

dialogueLines.speaker: athridas
dialogueLines.text: By the stars. This is quite disturbing indeed.

dialogueLines.speaker: athridas
dialogueLines.text: Rest tonight. Tomorrow I'll ask far more of you than a report.

pages.storyFunction: Ceremonial reward, closing

panels.title: The Moonwell's Blessing
panels.caption: That evening, Corithras Moonrage called them to the water's edge.

dialogueLines.speaker: corithras
dialogueLines.text: You go toward greater danger than you've yet known. Take these.

dialogueLines.speaker: corithras
dialogueLines.text: Keep this close when danger's real, Nova. It will help your spells hold steady.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Thank you, Corithras. I won't forget it.

dialogueLines.speaker: corithras
dialogueLines.text: And for you, Aala, ring this, and your wards will rise faster and hold stronger.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Thank you. I'll keep us all a little safer for it.

episodes.title: Nova and Aala 09 - The Barrow Den
episodes.subtitle: Nova and Aala 09 - The Barrow Den
episodes.sourceName: Nova and Aala/Nova and Aala 09 - The Barrow Den/Nova-and-Aala-09-The-Barrow-Den.pdf-project.json

pages.storyFunction: Bridge: time passes, word arrives

panels.title: Two Days of Waiting
panels.caption: Two days passed since their warning reached Athridas. Long enough that the new gifts no longer felt so strange in hand.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Getting the hang of this yet?

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Getting there.

panels.title: The Scout's Report
panels.caption: Then a Sentinel scout reached Dolanaar, breathless, with word from the west.

dialogueLines.speaker: athridas
dialogueLines.text: Then we've no more time to spare. Nova, Aala, with me.

pages.storyFunction: Briefing: the dual task

dialogueLines.speaker: athridas
dialogueLines.text: I've spent these two days consulting the ritual itself. The Barrow Den is worse than we feared. I need the Relics of Wakening from its sacred chests, but even blessed, the ritual won't take unless Ursal himself falls.

panels.title: The Relics Named
panels.caption: Four relics, four sacred chests: the Raven Claw Talisman, the Black Feather Quill, the Sapphire of Sky, and the Rune of Nesting.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Four chests, one furbolg-infested den. We'll manage, we always do.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Relics and Ursal. We won't come back until both are done.

dialogueLines.speaker: athridas
dialogueLines.text: Go carefully. And go together.

pages.storyFunction: Travel, rising tension

panels.title: West Toward Ban'ethil
panels.caption: West of Dolanaar, toward Ban'ethil Barrow Den.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Still trying to work out the kinks in this new bauble. It's working better than yesterday at least.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: More moss. The trail's thick with it, we're close.

panels.title: The Den Mouth
panels.caption: Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Once a sanctuary. Now a wound in the hillside.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Stay close.

pages.storyFunction: Tarindrella's reunion

panels.title: A Familiar Silhouette
panels.caption: Tarindrella, the dryad who once fought beside them against Githyiss stood waiting at the den's edge, exactly where she said she'd be.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Tarindrella! You found the stronghold.

dialogueLines.speaker: tarindrella
dialogueLines.text: I said I would come once I found it. Ban'ethil is worse than I feared.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Feels like old times already. Good to have you back.

dialogueLines.speaker: tarindrella
dialogueLines.text: I could say the same. Shall we?

pages.storyFunction: Descent + combat-lite montage

panels.title: Into the Lower Den
panels.caption: The Lower Den swallowed the daylight almost at once.

dialogueLines.speaker: tarindrella
dialogueLines.text: Watch the corners. They've grown bolder since I was last here.

panels.title: Furbolg Resistance
panels.caption: Nova's frostbolt cracked past one attacker while a pulse of Aala's purifying light staggered another.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Furbolg, incoming!

dialogueLines.speaker: tarindrella
dialogueLines.text: I'll hold the flank.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: 'Tis but a scratch.

dialogueLines.speaker: tarindrella
dialogueLines.text: That claw was corrupted. We can't just shrug it off.

panels.title: Cleared
panels.caption: The furbolg scattered, but the fight left its mark.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Once we've got real light and a moment's peace, I'll see to that properly.

pages.storyFunction: Relic retrieval + care beat

panels.title: The Sacred Chests
panels.caption: Four sacred chests, exactly as Athridas described, hidden deep in the Lower Den.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: One down. The Raven Claw Talisman.

panels.title: Sapphire and Rune
panels.caption: Two more chests, two more relics.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: This is what I've been saving it for. Hold still.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: The moonpetal lily antidote, thank goodness we still have it.

dialogueLines.speaker: tarindrella
dialogueLines.text: Wait, what's this? A shaman's totem.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Better bring it. Might matter later.

pages.storyFunction: Oben's ghost, the terrible choice

panels.title: A Ghost in the Den
panels.caption: A translucent figure drifted from the shadows, a night elf druid, both there and... not.

dialogueLines.speaker: oben
dialogueLines.text: Please don't be afraid. I need your help more than you know.

dialogueLines.speaker: oben
dialogueLines.text: That charm, was used in the shaman's ritual. I can sense it's evil.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: This is what separated you from your body?

dialogueLines.speaker: oben
dialogueLines.text: My own body walks these halls, animated and empty. To free me, you must still it, and only then use the charm upon it.

pages.storyFunction: The mercy, the release

panels.title: A Mercy, Not a Kill
panels.caption: There was no fight in it. Only a slow, deliberate act of release.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: The binding's arcane, laced through the whole body. I can see where it holds.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Then let it go gently.

dialogueLines.speaker: oben
dialogueLines.text: Free, at last. My thanks to you both. May we meet again, in a kinder hour.

pages.storyFunction: Deeper descent, Ursal briefing

panels.title: The Path to the Cleft
panels.caption: With the druid at peace behind them, the party proceeded into the den. The further they went, the corruption got thicker.

dialogueLines.speaker: tarindrella
dialogueLines.text: Ursal holds up in a place they call the Cleft, north from here. I've scouted the approach, he's not alone.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: This is it, then.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Together, like always.

pages.storyFunction: Ursal fight, building intensity

panels.title: Into the Cleft
panels.caption: The Cleft opened into a wide hollow, and there, amid broken furbolg banners, Ursal the Mauler waited.

dialogueLines.speaker: tarindrella
dialogueLines.text: Go! I'll keep the rest off you!

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Polymorph sheep. Fingers crossed, I've only managed this twice before!

panels.title: Aala's Cry
panels.caption: A wave of dread rolled outward, and the last of the furbolg fled.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Begone, all of you!

panels.title: Ursal Charges
panels.caption: Ursal's charge came like an unstoppable landslide.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: There, his club's stuck and guard's down!

pages.storyFunction: The decisive blow, immediate aftermath

panels.title: The Decisive Blow
panels.caption: Frostbolt and holy fire converged, and the corruption's hold broke at last. Ursal the Mauler fell still.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Together... now!

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Smite!

panels.title: The Moss Recedes
panels.caption: As if a held breath finally released, the fel-moss around them began to wither and fade.

dialogueLines.speaker: tarindrella
dialogueLines.text: Is it done?

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: It wasn't easy, but it's done.

pages.storyFunction: Farewell + road coda

dialogueLines.speaker: tarindrella
dialogueLines.text: Ursal's fall doesn't end this. The corruption's root lies deeper still, I mean to find it.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: When you need us, you have but to call and we will be there. What you are doing is for the good of everyone.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: Feels wrong, watching her go alone.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: She's not alone. She's got a whole forest listening for her.

panels.title: The Road Cleared
panels.caption: A few scattered Gnarlpine ambushers still prowled the road home. This time, they were dealt with quickly, and without a scratch. Skills were improving.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Frost Nova, that should hold them while we slip by.

panels.title: Dolanaar in Sight
panels.caption: Dolanaar's lanterns glimmered ahead, and for a moment, the road felt almost easy again.

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: Let's see if I've gotten better at this.

dialogueLines.speaker: aala
dialogueLines.text: I have to say, it looks better than the Persistent Tavern Loaf of Longevity. How cool is that you mages can conjure food?

pages.storyFunction: Return, closing warning

dialogueLines.speaker: nova
dialogueLines.text: All four relics, Ursal released, it's done.

dialogueLines.speaker: athridas
dialogueLines.text: The Druids of the Talon may finally wake in peace. You've done what I feared impossible.

panels.title: A Deeper Warning
panels.caption: Tarindrella was already following the scent, but that road belongs to another day.

dialogueLines.speaker: athridas
dialogueLines.text: Yet Ursal was not the root of this corruption. Somewhere in this forest, the true source still festers.
